title: Set exposure bracketing

steps.text: Hold the BKT button (front, below the flash button)
Spin the rear dial to choose frames: 3F or 5F
Spin the front dial to set the step: 0.7–1.0 EV for landscapes, wider for the corona
Fire the whole sequence — continuous release runs it in one press

tip: Totality: bracket wide (1/1000s → 1s) and don't review between frames — the clock is running.
